```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(mosaic)
library(data.table)
library(lubridate)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
list.files("data/raw", full.names=TRUE)

calls <- fread("../data/raw/APD_Computer_Aided_Dispatch_Incidents.csv") #dataset renamed to calls
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
# datetime->date & time

# renaming columns to change
names(calls) [6] <- "response_datetime" 
names(calls) [11] <- "arrived_datetime"
names(calls) [12] <- "closed_datetime"


# breaking columns by index
calls <- calls %>%
  mutate(response_time = str_sub(response_datetime,12,23),
         response_date = str_sub(response_datetime,1,11),
         arrived_time = str_sub(arrived_datetime,12,23),
         arrived_date = str_sub(arrived_datetime,1,11),
         closed_time = str_sub(closed_datetime,12,23),
         closed_date = str_sub(closed_datetime,1,11))

# checking my work
head(calls$response_time)
head(calls$response_date)
head(calls$arrived_time)
head(calls$arrived_date)
head(calls$closed_time)
head(calls$closed_date)

head(calls)
```




```{r}
# Frequency Table by Call Type
as_tibble(calls) %>%
  count(`Initial Problem Category`, sort = TRUE) %>%
  print(n = 100)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
# Call Type Classification
calls_sorted <- calls %>%
  mutate(
    calls_disorder = as.integer(`Initial Problem Category` %in% c("Disturbance", "Disorderly Conduct", "Property Damage/Vandalism", "Drugs", "Prositution", "Sex Crimes")),
    calls_behavior = as.integer(`Initial Problem Category` %in% c("Suspicious Things", "Trespassing")),
    calls_traffic = as.integer(`Initial Problem Category` == "Crashes"),
    calls_gun = as.integer(`Initial Problem Category` %in% c("Shoot/Stab", "Weapons/Firearms Violations")),
         
        calls_robbery = as.integer(`Initial Problem Category` == "Robbery"),
        calls_aggravated_assault = as.integer(`Initial Problem Category` == "Aggravated Assault"),
        calls_burglary = as.integer(`Initial Problem Category` == "Burglary"),
        calls_theft = as.integer(`Initial Problem Category` == "Theft"),
        calls_mv_theft = as.integer(`Initial Problem Category` == "Auto Theft"),
  
            calls_violent = calls_robbery + calls_aggravated_assault,
            calls_property = calls_burglary + calls_theft + calls_mv_theft,
            calls_index = calls_violent + calls_property
)
```


```{r, fig_width = 20}
# only getting the minute integers from the time of day
calls_sorted <- calls_sorted %>%
  mutate(
    response_minute = as.integer(str_sub(response_time,4,5)),
    arrived_minute = as.integer(str_sub(arrived_time,4,5)),
    closed_minute = as.integer(str_sub(closed_time,4,5))
  )

# distribution of all times together
by_minute_type <- bind_rows(
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_robbery == 1) %>% count(minute = response_minute) %>% mutate(type = "Robbery"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_aggravated_assault == 1) %>% count(minute = response_minute) %>% mutate(type = "Aggravated Assault"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_burglary == 1) %>% count(minute = response_minute) %>% mutate(type = "Burglary"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_theft == 1) %>% count(minute = response_minute) %>% mutate(type = "Theft"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_mv_theft == 1) %>% count(minute = response_minute) %>% mutate(type = "MV Theft"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_disorder == 1) %>% count(minute = response_minute) %>% mutate(type = "Disorder"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_behavior == 1) %>% count(minute = response_minute) %>% mutate(type = "Susp/Unwanted"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_traffic == 1) %>% count(minute = response_minute) %>% mutate(type = "Traffic"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_gun == 1) %>% count(minute = response_minute) %>% mutate(type = "Gunshots")
)

# graphed distribution of 911 times by hour
ggplot(by_minute_type, aes(minute, n, color = type)) +
  geom_line() + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 59, by = 3)) +
  labs(title = "Austin 911 Times by Minute of the Hour and Call Type", x = "Minute", y = "Calls") +
  theme_minimal()
  
```

```{r, fig_width = 20}

calls_sorted <- calls_sorted %>%
   mutate(
    response_hour = as.numeric(format(strptime(response_time, format = "%I:%M:%S %p"),"%H")),
    arrived_hour = as.numeric(format(strptime(arrived_time, format = "%I:%M:%S %p"), "%H")),
    closed_hour = as.numeric(format(strptime(closed_time, format = "%I:%M:%S %p"), "%H"))
  )


by_hour_type <- bind_rows(
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_robbery == 1) %>% count(hour = response_hour) %>% mutate(type = "Robbery"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_aggravated_assault == 1) %>% count(hour = response_hour) %>% mutate(type = "Aggravated Assault"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_burglary == 1) %>% count(hour = response_hour) %>% mutate(type = "Burglary"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_theft == 1) %>% count(hour = response_hour) %>% mutate(type = "Theft"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_mv_theft == 1) %>% count(hour = response_hour) %>% mutate(type = "MV Theft"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_disorder == 1) %>% count(hour = response_hour) %>% mutate(type = "Disorder"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_behavior == 1) %>% count(hour = response_hour) %>% mutate(type = "Susp/Unwanted"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_traffic == 1) %>% count(hour = response_hour) %>% mutate(type = "Traffic"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_gun == 1) %>% count(hour = response_hour) %>% mutate(type = "Gunshots")
)

# graphed distribution of 911 times by hour
ggplot(by_hour_type, aes(hour, n, color = type)) +
  geom_line() + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 59, by = 3)) +
  labs(title = "Austin 911 Times by Hour of the Day and Call Type", x = "hour", y = "Calls")+

```

```{r}
# day-year
by_date <- calls_sorted %>%
  mutate(
    date_response = as_date(mdy_hms(response_datetime)),
    date_arrived = as_date(mdy_hms(arrived_datetime)),
    date_closed = as_date(mdy_hms(closed_datetime)))
  
by_day_type <- bind_rows(
  by_date %>% filter(calls_robbery == 1) %>% count(day = date_response) %>% mutate(type = "Robbery"),
  by_date %>% filter(calls_aggravated_assault == 1) %>% count(day = date_response) %>% mutate(type = "Aggravated Assault"),
  by_date %>% filter(calls_burglary == 1) %>% count(day = date_response) %>% mutate(type = "Burglary"),
  by_date %>% filter(calls_theft == 1) %>% count(day= date_response) %>% mutate(type = "Theft"), 
  by_date %>% filter(calls_mv_theft == 1) %>% count(day = date_response) %>% mutate(type = "MV Theft"),
  by_date %>% filter(calls_disorder == 1) %>% count(day = date_response) %>% mutate(type = "Disorder"),
  by_date %>% filter(calls_behavior == 1) %>% count(day = date_response) %>% mutate(type = "Susp/Unwanted"),
  by_date %>% filter(calls_traffic == 1) %>% count(day = date_response) %>% mutate(type = "Traffic"),
  by_date %>% filter(calls_gun == 1) %>% count(day = date_response) %>% mutate(type = "Gunshots")
)

  
ggplot(by_day_type, aes(day, n, color = type, group = type)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Austin 911 Calls by Timeline and Type", x = "Day", y = "Calls") 


```

```{r}
# day-year w/o outlier
by_date <- calls_sorted %>%
  mutate(
    date_response = as_date(mdy_hms(response_datetime)),
    date_arrived = as_date(mdy_hms(arrived_datetime)),
    date_closed = as_date(mdy_hms(closed_datetime)))
  
by_day_type <- bind_rows(
  by_date %>% filter(calls_robbery == 1) %>% count(day = date_response) %>% mutate(type = "Robbery"),
  by_date %>% filter(calls_aggravated_assault == 1) %>% count(day = date_response) %>% mutate(type = "Aggravated Assault"),
  by_date %>% filter(calls_burglary == 1) %>% count(day = date_response) %>% mutate(type = "Burglary"),
  by_date %>% filter(calls_theft == 1) %>% count(day= date_response) %>% mutate(type = "Theft"), 
  by_date %>% filter(calls_mv_theft == 1) %>% count(day = date_response) %>% mutate(type = "MV Theft"),
  by_date %>% filter(calls_disorder == 1) %>% count(day = date_response) %>% mutate(type = "Disorder"),
  by_date %>% filter(calls_behavior == 1) %>% count(day = date_response) %>% mutate(type = "Susp/Unwanted"),
  by_date %>% filter(calls_traffic == 1) %>% count(day = date_response) %>% mutate(type = "Traffic"),
  by_date %>% filter(calls_gun == 1) %>% count(day = date_response) %>% mutate(type = "Gunshots")
)

  
ggplot(by_day_type, aes(day, n, color = type, group = type)) +
  geom_line(alpha = .7) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~type, scales = "free_y") + 
  labs(title = "Austin 911 Calls by Timeline and Type (Cleaned)", x = "Day", y = "Calls") +
  theme_minimal() 
  


```

```{r}
# heatmap all calls

by_time <- calls_sorted %>%
  mutate(hour = hour(mdy_hms(response_datetime)),
         day_of_week = wday(mdy_hms(response_datetime))
         )

heatmap <- by_time %>%
  count(day_of_week, hour)

ggplot(heatmap, aes(hour, day_of_week, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:23) +
  theme_minimal() +
   labs(title = "Austin 911 Call Volume Heatmap by Day and Hour", x = "Hour of Day", y = "Day of Week", fill = "Total Calls") 

```

```{r}
by_time <- calls_sorted %>%
  mutate(hour = hour(mdy_hms(response_datetime)),
         day_of_week = wday(mdy_hms(response_datetime))
         )

heatmap_by_type <- bind_rows(
  by_time %>% filter(calls_robbery == 1) %>% count(day_of_week, hour) %>% mutate(type = "Robbery"),
  by_time %>% filter(calls_aggravated_assault == 1) %>% count(day_of_week, hour) %>% mutate(type = "Aggravated Assault"),
  by_time %>% filter(calls_burglary == 1) %>% count(day_of_week, hour) %>% mutate(type = "Burglary"),
  by_time %>% filter(calls_theft == 1) %>% count(day_of_week, hour) %>% mutate(type = "Theft"), 
  by_time %>% filter(calls_mv_theft == 1) %>% count(day_of_week, hour) %>% mutate(type = "MV Theft"),
  by_time %>% filter(calls_disorder == 1) %>% count(day_of_week, hour) %>% mutate(type = "Disorder"),
  by_time %>% filter(calls_behavior == 1) %>% count(day_of_week, hour) %>% mutate(type = "Susp/Unwanted"),
  by_time %>% filter(calls_traffic == 1) %>% count(day_of_week, hour) %>% mutate(type = "Traffic"),
  by_time %>% filter(calls_gun == 1) %>% count(day_of_week, hour) %>% mutate(type = "Gunshots")
)
ggplot(heatmap_by_type, aes(hour, day_of_week, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 23, by = 4)) +
  facet_wrap(~type, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
   labs(title = "Austin 911 Call Volume Heatmap by Day and Hour", x = "Hour of Day", y = "Day of Week", fill = "Total Calls") 

# By percent so we can see the smaller types

heatmap_by_type_percent <- heatmap_by_type %>%
  group_by(type) %>%
  mutate( percent = (n / sum(n)) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(heatmap_by_type_percent, aes(hour, day_of_week, fill = percent)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 23, by = 4)) +
  facet_wrap(~type, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
   labs(title = "Austin 911 Call Volume Heatmap by Day and Hour", x = "Hour of Day", y = "Day of Week", fill = "% of Types Total") 

```
